name: Mento Dollar
oneLiner: USDm is Mento's oracle-priced dollar stablecoin on Celo and Monad (formerly cUSD), backed by the live Mento reserve and CDP/liquidity infrastructure.
collateral: Mento reserve holding AUSD, sUSDS, CELO, USDT, EURC, USDC, and stETH; reserve composition is pulled from the live Mento reserve API and changes over time.
pegMechanism: Mento V3 reserve-backed model: users mint and redeem USDm against reserve assets through Mento rails, with oracle pricing, circuit breakers, and reserve governance replacing the old CDP framing.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Mento documents USDm as Reserve-backed by fiat-backed collateral including USDC, USDT, and USDS, with reserve composition and liquidity strategy controlled by MENTO governance. The reviewed Celo and Monad token owner is a Mento Safe, while the NEAR bridge deployment is controlled by the parent account a11bd.near. No single holder-freeze function is established for every material deployment, so inherited upstream exposure is retained rather than asserting a direct token blacklist.

mintAuthority.summary: USDm minting on Celo routes through Mento reserve/Broker rails, with token owner resolving to a 4/6 Mento Safe. controls.label: NEAR cUSD bridge token (EOA-controlled)
controls.evidence: NEAR rpc.mainnet.near.org confirmed: cusd.token.a11bd.near is a deployed contract (code_hash 2K5PmiMQ...). Parent account a11bd.near is a plain EOA (code_hash 11111..., no contract, no staking lock, ~11.69 NEAR balance). As the parent account on NEAR, a11bd.near controls the subaccount cusd.token.a11bd.near. No owner/controller view method is exposed on the bridge contract.

sources.label: USDm Celo token owner() re-read 2026-07-16 = 4-of-6 Mento Safe

review.evidence: At Celo block 69286148, Safe API (celo chain) confirmed 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 has threshold 4, 6 owners, no modules, zero guard, fallbackHandler 0xfd0732Dc9E303f09fCEf3a7388Ad10A83459Ec99, masterCopy 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762 (Safe L2 v1.4.1). isMinter(Broker 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD) = true. Monad confirmed at block 80,612,848: same Safe address is owner, threshold 4, 7 signers (including one additional signer not on Celo). NEAR: parent account a11bd.near is a plain EOA (no contract, ~11.69 NEAR, no lock) controlling the bridge subaccount cusd.token.a11bd.near; no owner view method exposed. USDm (Mento Dollar) reserve backing is published only on Mento's own reserve dashboard (self-verification, no independent third-party attestor), so reconciliation is unknown, and no financial regulator supervises the Mento protocol, so supervision is none. Unlike the Mento FX variants whose token owner is the 48-hour Mento Timelock, the USDm Celo token owner re-read on 2026-07-16 is the 4-of-6 Mento Safe 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 with no execution delay, and the NEAR deployment is minted by a plain EOA (a11bd.near); the mint admin is therefore self-controlled with no independent delay, so the encoding-derived unbounded cap is not superseded and no raiseable escape is earned.

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDm is a USD-pegged reserve-backed stablecoin designed for payments and cross-border transfers, meeting the GENIUS Act's functional definition of a payment stablecoin. The issuing entity (Mento Labs GmbH) is a German GmbH domiciled in Berlin with no identified US operations, subsidiary, or regulatory presence. The protocol is governed by Mento DAO (MENTO token holders) with a 4/7 multisig Safe as the Celo token owner. Market focus is Africa and emerging markets (MiniPay in Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana). Market cap ~$14M as of June 2026.

foreignExceptionEvidence.summary: No foreign-issuer registration or comparability determination has been sought by Mento Labs GmbH. The issuer has made no public statements about pursuing GENIUS Act compliance or OCC foreign-issuer registration. GENIUS foreign-issuer rules remain in proposed-rules phase as of June 2026.

genius.notes: The shortlisting rationale cited a named US-nexus issuer (Mento Labs) but this is factually incorrect — Mento Labs GmbH is domiciled in Berlin, Germany. USDm meets the functional definition of a payment stablecoin (USD-peg, reserve-backed, designed for payments) but the issuer is a foreign entity with no US regulatory engagement. The GENIUS Act foreign-issuer pathway could theoretically apply when the framework is effective, but no steps toward compliance have been taken. Conservative status: no-public-authorization-found. Protocol is DAO-governed; market cap approximately $14M; primary user base is Africa and emerging markets via MiniPay. No geo-restriction on US access but no US-targeted regulatory posture.
